'''Pir'pwn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] warrior who resided on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:PirPwnGazebo.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The gazebo in which Captain Pir'pwn safeguarded his glowing stone]]
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Pir'pwn was a member of the [[Rorgungans]],<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> a group of extremist Gungans who violently opposed [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass's]] support of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo's human population]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and rejected any alliance between humans and Gungans.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref>

Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he occupied a gazebo perched atop a mountain. While in the gazebo, he sat on a [[Throne/Legends|throne]] while safeguarding a mysterious glowing [[Mineral/Legends|stone]] placed on an altar in front of him. He was protected by a group of fellow Rorgunan [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]].<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] attacked the Gungans and eventually stole the rock.<ref name="SWG:GRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Pir'pwn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GRC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pir'pwn was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]]" update, released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter History 2007">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66959&resource=publish|text=Chapter History 2007}}</ref>
